definitions.explanation: Items and supplies provided for use in an office, school, or other facility. Refers to durable goods that belong to an organization rather than to individuals.

examples.japanese: {備品|びひん}を{管理|かんり}する。
{会社|かいしゃ}の{備品|びひん}を{私的|してき}に{使|つか}ってはいけない。
examples.english: You must not use company equipment for personal purposes.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいオフィスに{必要|ひつよう}な{備品|びひん}のリストを{作|つく}ってください。
examples.english: Please make a list of the equipment needed for the new office.

notes:
{備品|びひん} is composed of {備|び} (prepare, equip) + {品|ひん} (goods, article).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {備品|びひん}を{管理|かんり}する: to manage equipment
- {備品|びひん}を{購入|こうにゅう}する: to purchase supplies
- {備品|びひん}{台帳|だいちょう}: equipment ledger
- オフィス{備品|びひん}: office supplies/equipment

USAGE: Refers to durable items that belong to an organization — desks, chairs, projectors, etc. Consumable items like paper and pens are typically called {消耗品|しょうもうひん} instead.
